plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: WCA uses your location when you announce car line pickup and, if you turn on automatic check-in, to notice when you arrive at school. Your location isn't stored or shared.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: WCA uses your location when you tap I'm here at car line pickup, so the school knows you've arrived. Your location isn't stored or shared.
